roles.title: Product Manager, Fleet Management Tools
roles.location: Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA

bullets: Define and execute the product roadmap for Fleet Operations tooling to enable Waymo operations and Waymo fleet partners to operate markets efficiently and seamlessly
Collaborate with Operations, other Product managers, UX designers, UX researchers to uncover operational pain points and turn them into UX tools that delight operational…
Deeply understand real time metrics and monitoring systems that can empower market leaders to run the business efficiently and bring those insights to fleet tools

roles.title: Product Manager, Network Flows Optimization
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA

bullets: Define and execute the product roadmap for automated workflows that require network bandwidth in the depots (e.g. software downloads, data upload) which balances optimal use of…
Partner with data science and engineering to develop optimal techniques to manage these workflows
Partner with other Product Managers, Waymo Real Estate and Networking teams to align and execute on the optimal depot networking strategy
Collaborate with operations teams so they can effectively and seamlessly execute on the workflows in depot.

roles.title: Product Manager, Fleet Simulation
roles.location: Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA

bullets: Foster a culture of extensive pre-production testing and experimentation through a well functioning, highly capable and easy to use fleet simulation platform
Define and deliver on the roadmap for fleet wide simulation to evaluate impact of offboard changes to commercial performance (depot operations, ride hailing operations)
Collaborate with various engineering and product teams to understand types of changes they need to evaluate and build a roadmap that serves multiple internal stakeholders
Work with Data Analytics team to enable a simulation environment that enables experimentation of ML & OR models prior to launch
Understand Developer Experience necessary to support large scale adoption of this simulation platform and deliver front end tools necessary to drive adoption

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Autonomous Vehicle Reliability
roles.location: Mountain View, CA, US; San Francisco, CA, US

bullets: As Waymo expands to more freeways, on more platforms, in more regions, in more weather, understanding vehicle reliability becomes critical to ensuring we have a high quality and…
You will set the roadmap for how we evaluate the reliability of the Waymo driver: measure how, when and where the hardware or software fails and what happens as a result.
Be responsible for the onboard solutions,hardware changes, and testing strategies to minimize reliability failures, and mitigate issues in the field.
Look to the future at new hardware platforms, new geographic launches and new ODDs, and build the systems and tools to ensure we have a reliable vehicle as we grow.

roles.title: 2027 Summer Intern, MBA, Salesforce Product Owner

bullets: User Research: understanding the cross-functional needs that would be needed in a central tool, and what outside systems would need to be integrated
Design: facilitating planning and design for these user needs, in combination with our Salesforce PgM and external developers
Change Management: facilitating feedback sessions and the user teams’ transition into the new tooling.

roles.title: Group Product Manager, DevAI & Agentic Workflows

bullets: Define a compelling vision for Waymo’s DevAI platform, shaping how autonomous driving software is built by completely transforming internal workflows into AI-first paradigms.
Exercise a highly focused and disciplined mindset to ruthlessly prioritize investments. You will guide a high-impact core team in a rapidly changing technological landscape.
Act as the primary thought leader and educator on AI-Powered Devtools for all of Waymo’s engineers—cutting through the hype, organizing fragmented information (newsletters, new…
Own the developer productivity survey and engineering education programs, ensuring they are tightly aligned with and accelerating our DevAI strategy.
Resolve technical and strategic ambiguities, making highly complex product decisions that carry long-term strategic impact for all Waymo engineers.

roles.title: Product Manager, Growth
roles.location: Mountain View, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA

bullets: Build products, features & infrastructure to support Waymo’s ability to drive our trip growth.
Closely partner with XFN stakeholders in data science, marketing & operations to think about workflows and build tooling that improves velocity, experimentation and measurement.
Solve a diverse set of rider growth challenges related to success & efficiency of CAC and rider incentives.
Be a force for execution excellence, working across PMs, engineering, and cross functional partners (UX, data science, marketing, operations)
Develop and promote our growth product strategy with senior leaders

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Fleet Optimization
roles.location: San Francisco, CA, USA; Mountain View, CA, USA

bullets: Define and execute the product roadmap to optimize depot throughput and create a digital twin of Waymo’s depot resources, in collaboration with engineering and data science
Collaborate with Sales & Operations Planning team to ensure sufficient infrastructure and charging resources are available necessary to scale Waymo’s business
Partner with other Product Managers, UX Designers, UX Researchers to develop the UX tools and API to enable automated new depot bring-up

roles.title: Senior Product Manager, Simulation
roles.location: Mountain View, CA, US; San Francisco, CA, US

bullets: Define and champion a compelling product vision and strategy for Waymo’s AV simulator
Work with cross-functional teams, including product managers, operations, system engineering and safety experts to define product requirements
Collaborate with Engineering, Research, Systems Engineering, Safety, and Operations teams to gather requirements, align roadmaps, and ensure successful development and deployment…
Monitor and evaluate the performance of the simulator, identifying opportunities to improve realism and efficiency
Partner with research to build and leverage large-scale foundation models in Simulation
